column1: # M11-complexity-T2 (D-0141). The differential lane's CORPUS: one instance per line,
# TAB-separated. The instance is bench/diff/corpus/<id>.fzn.gz (gzip -9n, flattened with
# the baguette mznlib of the commit that recorded it -- the .fzn is the input, it is
# never re-flattened by the lane). The budget is BAGUETTE_NODE_LIMIT for that instance in
# every configuration, chosen so that one default run takes 1 to 10 s on fataepyc-06 and
# builds a learned database of thousands of constraints where the instance allows it.
# Columns: id, node budget, what it covers (constraint families after flattening; `PB`
# when `--stats` shows PB rows learned), where it comes from.
# Changing a budget or an instance is a change to the reference: record it with
# `scripts/diff_lane.sh --update --only ID` in the same commit, on the gated main binary.
